spec: Doc 10 FR-13 / Doc 06 NFR-06 — consumer contracts for Doc 10's durable consumption (S10 step 6; ADR 0011). Every consumer reads identifiers only and re-fetches truth under its own tenancy (SEC-07/Q7).
note: KbIndexMaintenanceConsumer reads variant_id + version_id and re-reads the version snapshot, the article's audience and the category's ai_usable from the rows — never article text from the bus. A superseded version (a later publish/unpublish won) is a no-op; an already-serving version is a no-op (idempotent on event_id in substance).
